name: agent-fs-tool-suite
body:
The agent filesystem tool suite: `apg_rm`, `apg_mv`, `apg_cp` (`opencode-suite/tools/apg_rm.ts`, `apg_mv.ts`, `apg_cp.ts`) plus the shared `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts` plumbing. Each tool takes the caller's `directory` plus the operation's path(s), performs a plain filesystem operation, and SELF-ENFORCES scope via `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.agentFsGlobs` (reads the acting agent's effective `edit`-action rules — the allow and deny entries, last match wins — from its opencode 2.x `permissions` array) and the pure `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.fsScopeDecision` (boundary + ordered allow/deny match).

For `requirements.requirement.code-writer-worktree-only-writes`, `fsScopeDecision` resolves the candidate against the caller-supplied `directory` and matches it against globs written relative to the session root, so the frames must agree; the decision resolves grants and candidate in ONE frame and refuses a code-writer path that resolves into the main checkout (outside every project worktree) whatever `directory` is passed. The way a tool learns the acting agent's identity under opencode 2.x is a plan decision (a spike against a real opencode 2.x; see `requirements.note.worktree-write-scope-decisions`). The tool files are in scope when the chosen mechanism changes their call into the lib. DRY per `global.constraint.decomposition-quality`; installed by `apg init` as plugins (`solution.component.agent-fs-install-registry`).

For `requirements.note.fs-scope-deny-mirror`, the fs scope EQUALS the `edit` scope, so the tools read the whole `edit` rule set (allow AND deny) and evaluate it in array order with the LAST matching entry winning; a path matched by zero entries is refused. `editAllowGlobs` / `agentFsGlobs` return ordered allow/deny rules; `fsScopeDecision` matches them last-match-wins; a pure unit test in `opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts` pins the deny/order semantics, and the boundary e2e pins the acting-agent scope read.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.fsScopeDecision`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.agentFsGlobs`, and the three tool files.
